definitions.content: Laboratory performing certain or all tests on a type of measuring instrument

notes.content: Note 1: A Test Laboratory is designated by an OIML Issuing Authority and approved by the Management Committee.
Note 2: A Test Laboratory may be an internal Test Laboratory of an OIML Issuing Authority, a thirdparty Test Laboratory or a Manufacturer's Test Laboratory.
Note 3: The OIML Issuing Authority, and not the Test Laboratory, is responsible for issuing the OIML type evaluation report.
